verses.second: let it soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil;

verses.first: Let it be to him like the cloak which he wraps around himself,
verses.second: and like the belt that he wears continually.

verses.first: Let this be the recompense from the Lord to my accusers,
verses.second: and to those who speak evil against me.

verses.first: But you, O Lord my God, oh, deal with me according to your Name;
verses.second: for your tender mercy’s sake, deliver me.

verses.first: For I am poor and needy,
verses.second: and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.first: I have faded away like a shadow when it lengthens;
verses.second: I am shaken off like a locust.

verses.first: My knees are weak through fasting,
verses.second: and my flesh is wasted and gaunt.

verses.first: I have become a reproach to them;
verses.second: they see and shake their heads.

verses.first: Help me, O Lord my God;
verses.second: save me for your mercy’s sake.

verses.first: Let them know that this is your hand,
verses.second: that you, O Lord, have done it.

verses.first: They may curse, but you will bless;
verses.second: let those who rise up against me be put to shame, and your servant will rejoice.

verses.first: Let my accusers be clothed with disgrace
verses.second: and wrap themselves in their shame as in a cloak.

verses.first: I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth;
verses.second: in the midst of the multitude will I praise him;

verses.first: Because he stands at the right hand of the needy,
verses.second: to save his life from those who would condemn him.

verses.first: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
verses.second: until I make your enemies your footstool.”

verses.first: The Lord will send the scepter of your power out of Zion,
verses.second: saying, “Rule over your enemies round about you.

verses.first: Princely state has been yours from the day of your birth;
verses.second: in the beauty of holiness have I begotten you, like dew from the womb of the morning.”

verses.first: The Lord has sworn and he will not recant:
verses.second: “You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.”

verses.first: The Lord who is at your right hand will smite kings in the day of his wrath;
verses.second: he will rule over the nations.

verses.first: He will heap high the corpses;
verses.second: he will smash heads over the wide earth.

verses.first: He will drink from the brook beside the road;
verses.second: therefore he will lift high his head.

verses.first: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart,
verses.second: in the assembly of the upright, in the congregation.

verses.first: Great are the deeds of the Lord!
verses.second: they are studied by all who delight in them.

verses.first: His work is full of majesty and splendor,
verses.second: and his righteousness endures for ever.

verses.first: He makes his marvelous works to be remembered;
verses.second: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.first: He gives food to those who fear him;
verses.second: he is ever mindful of his covenant.

verses.first: He has shown his people the power of his works
verses.second: in giving them the lands of the nations.

verses.first: The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice;
verses.second: all his commandments are sure.

verses.first: They stand fast for ever and ever,
verses.second: because they are done in truth and equity.

verses.first: He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant for ever;
verses.second: holy and awesome is his Name.

verses.first: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom;
verses.second: those who act accordingly have a good understanding; his praise endures for ever.

verses.first: Hallelujah! Happy are they who fear the Lord
verses.second: and have great delight in his commandments!

verses.first: Their descendants will be mighty in the land;
verses.second: the generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.first: Wealth and riches will be in their house,
verses.second: and their righteousness will last for ever.

verses.first: Light shines in the darkness for the upright;
verses.second: the righteous are merciful and full of compassion.

verses.first: It is good for them to be generous in lending
verses.second: and to manage their affairs with justice.

verses.first: For they will never be shaken;
verses.second: the righteous will be kept in everlasting remembrance.

verses.first: They will not be afraid of any evil rumors;
verses.second: their heart is right; they put their trust in the Lord.

verses.first: Their heart is established and will not shrink,
verses.second: until they see their desire upon their enemies.

verses.first: They have given freely to the poor,
verses.second: and their righteousness stands fast for ever; they will hold up their head with honor.

verses.first: The wicked will see it and be angry; they will gnash their teeth and pine away;
verses.second: the desires of the wicked will perish.

verses.first: Hallelujah! Give praise, you servants of the Lord;
verses.second: praise the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: Let the Name of the Lord be blessed,
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: From the rising of the sun to its going down
verses.second: let the Name of the Lord be praised.

verses.first: The Lord is high above all nations,
verses.second: and his glory above the heavens.

verses.first: Who is like the Lord our God, who sits enthroned on high
verses.second: but stoops to behold the heavens and the earth?

verses.first: He takes up the weak out of the dust
verses.second: and lifts up the poor from the ashes.

verses.first: He sets them with the princes,
verses.second: with the princes of his people.

verses.first: He makes the woman of a childless house
verses.second: to be a joyful mother of children.

verses.first: Hallelujah! When Israel came out of Egypt,
verses.second: the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,

verses.first: Judah became God’s sanctuary
verses.second: and Israel his dominion.

verses.first: The sea beheld it and fled;
verses.second: Jordan turned and went back.

verses.first: The mountains skipped like rams,
verses.second: and the little hills like young sheep.

verses.first: What ailed you, O sea, that you fled?
verses.second: O Jordan, that you turned back?

verses.first: You mountains, that you skipped like rams?
verses.second: you little hills like young sheep?

verses.first: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,
verses.second: at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.first: Who turned the hard rock into a pool of water
verses.second: and flint-stone into a flowing spring.

verses.first: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your Name give glory;
verses.second: because of your love and because of your faithfulness.

verses.first: Why should the heathen say,
verses.second: “Where then is their God?”

verses.first: Our God is in heaven;
verses.second: whatever he wills to do he does.

verses.first: Their idols are silver and gold,
verses.second: the work of human hands.

verses.first: They have mouths, but they cannot speak;
verses.second: eyes have they, but they cannot see;

verses.first: They have ears, but they cannot hear;
verses.second: noses, but they cannot smell;

verses.first: They have hands, but they cannot feel; feet, but they cannot walk;
verses.second: they make no sound with their throat.

verses.first: Those who make them are like them,
verses.second: and so are all who put their trust in them.

verses.first: O Israel, trust in the Lord;
verses.second: he is their help and their shield.

verses.first: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord;
verses.second: he is their help and their shield.

verses.first: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord;
verses.second: he is their help and their shield.

verses.first: The Lord has been mindful of us, and he will bless us;
verses.second: he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;

verses.first: He will bless those who fear the Lord,
verses.second: both small and great together.

verses.first: May the Lord increase you more and more,
verses.second: you and your children after you.

verses.first: May you be blessed by the Lord,
verses.second: the maker of heaven and earth.

verses.first: The heaven of heavens is the Lord’s,
verses.second: but he entrusted the earth to its peoples.

verses.first: The dead do not praise the Lord,
verses.second: nor all those who go down into silence;

verses.first: But we will bless the Lord,
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore. Hallelujah!

verses.first: I love the Lord, because he has heard the voice of my supplication,
verses.second: because he has inclined his ear to me whenever I called upon him.

verses.first: The cords of death entangled me; the grip of the grave took hold of me;
verses.second: I came to grief and sorrow.

verses.first: Then I called upon the Name of the Lord:
verses.second: “O Lord, I pray you, save my life.”

verses.first: Gracious is the Lord and righteous;
verses.second: our God is full of compassion.

verses.first: The Lord watches over the innocent;
verses.second: I was brought very low, and he helped me.

verses.first: Turn again to your rest, O my soul,
verses.second: for the Lord has treated you well.

verses.first: For you have rescued my life from death,
verses.second: my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.

verses.first: I will walk in the presence of the Lord
verses.second: in the land of the living.

verses.first: I believed, even when I said, “I have been brought very low.”
verses.second: In my distress I said, “No one can be trusted.”

verses.first: How shall I repay the Lord
verses.second: for all the good things he has done for me?

verses.first: I will lift up the cup of salvation
verses.second: and call upon the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
verses.second: in the presence of all his people.

verses.first: Precious in the sight of the Lord
verses.second: is the death of his servants.

verses.first: O Lord, I am your servant;
verses.second: I am your servant and the child of your handmaid; you have freed me from my bonds.

verses.first: I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving
verses.second: and call upon the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
verses.second: in the presence of all his people,

verses.first: In the courts of the Lord’s house,
verses.second: in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Praise the Lord, all you nations;
verses.second: laud him, all you peoples.

verses.first: For his loving-kindness toward us is great,
verses.second: and the faithfulness of the Lord endures for ever. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
verses.second: his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Let Israel now proclaim,
verses.second: “His mercy endures for ever.”

verses.first: Let the house of Aaron now proclaim,
verses.second: “His mercy endures for ever.”

verses.first: Let those who fear the Lord now proclaim,
verses.second: “His mercy endures for ever.”

verses.first: I called to the Lord in my distress;
verses.second: the Lord answered by setting me free.

verses.first: The Lord is at my side, therefore I will not fear;
verses.second: what can anyone do to me?

verses.first: The Lord is at my side to help me;
verses.second: I will triumph over those who hate me.

verses.first: It is better to rely on the Lord
verses.second: than to put any trust in flesh.

verses.first: It is better to rely on the Lord
verses.second: than to put any trust in rulers.

verses.first: All the ungodly encompass me;
verses.second: in the name of the Lord I will repel them.

verses.first: They hem me in, they hem me in on every side;
verses.second: in the name of the Lord I will repel them.

verses.first: They swarm about me like bees; they blaze like a fire of thorns;
verses.second: in the name of the Lord I will repel them.

verses.first: I was pressed so hard that I almost fell,
verses.second: but the Lord came to my help.

verses.first: The Lord is my strength and my song,
verses.second: and he has become my salvation.

verses.first: There is a sound of exultation and victory
verses.second: in the tents of the righteous:

verses.first: “The right hand of the Lord has triumphed!
verses.second: the right hand of the Lord is exalted! the right hand of the Lord has triumphed!”

verses.first: I shall not die, but live,
verses.second: and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.first: The Lord has punished me sorely,
verses.second: but he did not hand me over to death.

verses.first: Open for me the gates of righteousness;
verses.second: I will enter them; I will offer thanks to the Lord.

verses.first: “This is the gate of the Lord;
verses.second: he who is righteous may enter.”

verses.first: I will give thanks to you, for you answered me
verses.second: and have become my salvation.

verses.first: The same stone which the builders rejected
verses.second: has become the chief cornerstone.

verses.first: This is the Lord’s doing,
verses.second: and it is marvelous in our eyes.

verses.first: On this day the Lord has acted;
verses.second: we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.first: Hosannah, Lord, hosannah!
verses.second: Lord, send us now success.

verses.first: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord;
verses.second: we bless you from the house of the Lord.

verses.first: God is the Lord; he has shined upon us;
verses.second: form a procession with branches up to the horns of the altar.

verses.first: “You are my God, and I will thank you;
verses.second: you are my God, and I will exalt you.”

verses.first: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
verses.second: his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Happy are they whose way is blameless,
verses.second: who walk in the law of the Lord!

verses.first: Happy are they who observe his decrees
verses.second: and seek him with all their hearts!

verses.first: Who never do any wrong,
verses.second: but always walk in his ways.

verses.first: You laid down your commandments,
verses.second: that we should fully keep them.

verses.first: Oh, that my ways were made so direct
verses.second: that I might keep your statutes!

verses.first: Then I should not be put to shame,
verses.second: when I regard all your commandments.

verses.first: I will thank you with an unfeigned heart,
verses.second: when I have learned your righteous judgments.

verses.first: I will keep your statutes;
verses.second: do not utterly forsake me.

verses.first: How shall a young man cleanse his way?
verses.second: By keeping to your words.

verses.first: With my whole heart I seek you;
verses.second: let me not stray from your commandments.

verses.first: I treasure your promise in my heart,
verses.second: that I may not sin against you.

verses.first: Blessed are you, O Lord;
verses.second: instruct me in your statutes.

verses.first: With my lips will I recite
verses.second: all the judgments of your mouth.

verses.first: I have taken greater delight in the way of your decrees
verses.second: than in all manner of riches.

verses.first: I will meditate on your commandments
verses.second: and give attention to your ways.

verses.first: My delight is in your statutes;
verses.second: I will not forget your word.

verses.first: Deal bountifully with your servant,
verses.second: that I may live and keep your word.

verses.first: Open my eyes, that I may see
verses.second: the wonders of your law.

verses.first: I am a stranger here on earth;
verses.second: do not hide your commandments from me.

verses.first: My soul is consumed at all times
verses.second: with longing for your judgments.

verses.first: You have rebuked the insolent;
verses.second: cursed are they who stray from your commandments!

verses.first: Turn from me shame and rebuke,
verses.second: for I have kept your decrees.

verses.first: Even though rulers sit and plot against me,
verses.second: I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.first: For your decrees are my delight,
verses.second: and they are my counselors.

verses.first: My soul cleaves to the dust;
verses.second: give me life according to your word.

verses.first: I have confessed my ways, and you answered me;
verses.second: instruct me in your statutes.

verses.first: Make me understand the way of your commandments,
verses.second: that I may meditate on your marvelous works.

verses.first: My soul melts away for sorrow;
verses.second: strengthen me according to your word.

verses.first: Take from me the way of lying;
verses.second: let me find grace through your law.

verses.first: I have chosen the way of faithfulness;
verses.second: I have set your judgments before me.

verses.first: I hold fast to your decrees;
verses.second: O Lord, let me not be put to shame.

verses.first: I will run the way of your commandments,
verses.second: for you have set my heart at liberty.

verses.first: Teach me, O Lord, the way of your statutes,
verses.second: and I shall keep it to the end.

verses.first: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law;
verses.second: I shall keep it with all my heart.

verses.first: Make me go in the path of your commandments,
verses.second: for that is my desire.

verses.first: Incline my heart to your decrees
verses.second: and not to unjust gain.

verses.first: Turn my eyes from watching what is worthless;
verses.second: give me life in your ways.

verses.first: Fulfill your promise to your servant,
verses.second: which you make to those who fear you.

verses.first: Turn away the reproach which I dread,
verses.second: because your judgments are good.

verses.first: Behold, I long for your commandments;
verses.second: in your righteousness preserve my life.

verses.first: Let your loving-kindness come to me, O Lord,
verses.second: and your salvation, according to your promise.

verses.first: Then shall I have a word for those who taunt me,
verses.second: because I trust in your words.

verses.first: Do not take the word of truth out of my mouth,
verses.second: for my hope is in your judgments.

verses.first: I shall continue to keep your law;
verses.second: I shall keep it for ever and ever.

verses.first: I will walk at liberty,
verses.second: because I study your commandments.

verses.first: I will tell of your decrees before kings
verses.second: and will not be ashamed.

verses.first: I delight in your commandments,
verses.second: which I have always loved.

verses.first: I will lift up my hands to your commandments,
verses.second: and I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.first: Remember your word to your servant,
verses.second: because you have given me hope.

verses.first: This is my comfort in my trouble,
verses.second: that your promise gives me life.

verses.first: The proud have derided me cruelly,
verses.second: but I have not turned from your law.

verses.first: When I remember your judgments of old,
verses.second: O Lord, I take great comfort.

verses.first: I am filled with a burning rage,
verses.second: because of the wicked who forsake your law.

verses.first: Your statutes have been like songs to me
verses.second: wherever I have lived as a stranger.

verses.first: I remember your Name in the night, O Lord,
verses.second: and dwell upon your law.

verses.first: This is how it has been with me,
verses.second: because I have kept your commandments.

verses.first: You only are my portion, O Lord;
verses.second: I have promised to keep your words.

verses.first: I entreat you with all my heart,
verses.second: be merciful to me according to your promise.

verses.first: I have considered my ways
verses.second: and turned my feet toward your decrees.

verses.first: I hasten and do not tarry
verses.second: to keep your commandments.

verses.first: Though the cords of the wicked entangle me,
verses.second: I do not forget your law.

verses.first: At midnight I will rise to give you thanks,
verses.second: because of your righteous judgments.

verses.first: I am a companion of all who fear you;
verses.second: and of those who keep your commandments.

verses.first: The earth, O Lord, is full of your love;
verses.second: instruct me in your statutes.

verses.first: O Lord, you have dealt graciously with your servant,
verses.second: according to your word.

verses.first: Teach me discernment and knowledge,
verses.second: for I have believed in your commandments.

verses.first: Before I was afflicted I went astray,
verses.second: but now I keep your word.

verses.first: You are good and you bring forth good;
verses.second: instruct me in your statutes.

verses.first: The proud have smeared me with lies,
verses.second: but I will keep your commandments with my whole heart.

verses.first: Their heart is gross and fat,
verses.second: but my delight is in your law.

verses.first: It is good for me that I have been afflicted,
verses.second: that I might learn your statutes.

verses.first: The law of your mouth is dearer to me
verses.second: than thousands in gold and silver.

verses.first: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;
verses.second: give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

verses.first: Those who fear you will be glad when they see me,
verses.second: because I trust in your word.

verses.first: I know, O Lord, that your judgments are right
verses.second: and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

verses.first: Let your loving-kindness be my comfort,
verses.second: as you have promised to your servant.

verses.first: Let your compassion come to me, that I may live,
verses.second: for your law is my delight.

verses.first: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they wrong me with lies;
verses.second: but I will meditate on your commandments.

verses.first: Let those who fear you turn to me,
verses.second: and also those who know your decrees.

verses.first: Let my heart be sound in your statutes,
verses.second: that I may not be put to shame.

verses.first: My soul has longed for your salvation;
verses.second: I have put my hope in your word.

verses.first: My eyes have failed from watching for your promise,
verses.second: and I say, “When will you comfort me?”

verses.first: I have become like a leather flask in the smoke,
verses.second: but I have not forgotten your statutes.

verses.first: How much longer must I wait?
verses.second: when will you give judgment against those who persecute me?

verses.first: The proud have dug pits for me;
verses.second: they do not keep your law.

verses.first: All your commandments are true;
verses.second: help me, for they persecute me with lies.

verses.first: They had almost made an end of me on earth,
verses.second: but I have not forsaken your commandments.

verses.first: In your loving-kindness, revive me,
verses.second: that I may keep the decrees of your mouth. Lamedh In æternum, Domine

verses.first: O Lord, your word is everlasting;
verses.second: it stands firm in the heavens.

verses.first: Your faithfulness remains from one generation to another;
verses.second: you established the earth, and it abides.

verses.first: By your decree these continue to this day,
verses.second: for all things are your servants.

verses.first: If my delight had not been in your law,
verses.second: I should have perished in my affliction.

verses.first: I will never forget your commandments,
verses.second: because by them you give me life.

verses.first: I am yours; oh, that you would save me!
verses.second: for I study your commandments.

verses.first: Though the wicked lie in wait for me to destroy me,
verses.second: I will apply my mind to your decrees.

verses.first: I see that all things come to an end,
verses.second: but your commandment has no bounds.

verses.first: Oh, how I love your law!
verses.second: all the day long it is in my mind.

verses.first: Your commandment has made me wiser than my enemies,
verses.second: and it is always with me.

verses.first: I have more understanding than all my teachers,
verses.second: for your decrees are my study.

verses.first: I am wiser than the elders,
verses.second: because I observe your commandments.

verses.first: I restrain my feet from every evil way,
verses.second: that I may keep your word.

verses.first: I do not shrink from your judgments,
verses.second: because you yourself have taught me.

verses.first: How sweet are your words to my taste!
verses.second: they are sweeter than honey to my mouth.

verses.first: Through your commandments I gain understanding;
verses.second: therefore I hate every lying way.

verses.first: Your word is a lantern to my feet
verses.second: and a light upon my path.

verses.first: I have sworn and am determined
verses.second: to keep your righteous judgments.

verses.first: I am deeply troubled;
verses.second: preserve my life, O Lord, according to your word.

verses.first: Accept, O Lord, the willing tribute of my lips,
verses.second: and teach me your judgments.

verses.first: My life is always in my hand,
verses.second: yet I do not forget your law.

verses.first: The wicked have set a trap for me,
verses.second: but I have not strayed from your commandments.

verses.first: Your decrees are my inheritance for ever;
verses.second: truly, they are the joy of my heart.

verses.first: I have applied my heart to fulfill your statutes
verses.second: for ever and to the end.

verses.first: I hate those who have a divided heart,
verses.second: but your law do I love.

verses.first: You are my refuge and shield;
verses.second: my hope is in your word.

verses.first: Away from me, you wicked!
verses.second: I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.first: Sustain me according to your promise, that I may live,
verses.second: and let me not be disappointed in my hope.

verses.first: Hold me up, and I shall be safe,
verses.second: and my delight shall be ever in your statutes.

verses.first: You spurn all who stray from your statutes;
verses.second: their deceitfulness is in vain.

verses.first: In your sight all the wicked of the earth are but dross;
verses.second: therefore I love your decrees.

verses.first: My flesh trembles with dread of you;
verses.second: I am afraid of your judgments.

verses.first: I have done what is just and right;
verses.second: do not deliver me to my oppressors.

verses.first: Be surety for your servant’s good;
verses.second: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.first: My eyes have failed from watching for your salvation
verses.second: and for your righteous promise.

verses.first: Deal with your servant according to your loving-kindness
verses.second: and teach me your statutes.

verses.first: I am your servant; grant me understanding,
verses.second: that I may know your decrees.

verses.first: It is time for you to act, O Lord,
verses.second: for they have broken your law.

verses.first: Truly, I love your commandments
verses.second: more than gold and precious stones.

verses.first: I hold all your commandments to be right for me;
verses.second: all paths of falsehood I abhor.

verses.first: Your decrees are wonderful;
verses.second: therefore I obey them with all my heart.

verses.first: When your word goes forth it gives light;
verses.second: it gives understanding to the simple.

verses.first: I open my mouth and pant;
verses.second: I long for your commandments.

verses.first: Turn to me in mercy,
verses.second: as you always do to those who love your Name.

verses.first: Steady my footsteps in your word;
verses.second: let no iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.first: Rescue me from those who oppress me,
verses.second: and I will keep your commandments.

verses.first: Let your countenance shine upon your servant
verses.second: and teach me your statutes.

verses.first: My eyes shed streams of tears,
verses.second: because people do not keep your law. Sadhe Justus es, Domine

verses.first: You are righteous, O Lord,
verses.second: and upright are your judgments.

verses.first: You have issued your decrees
verses.second: with justice and in perfect faithfulness.

verses.first: My indignation has consumed me,
verses.second: because my enemies forget your words.

verses.first: Your word has been tested to the uttermost,
verses.second: and your servant holds it dear.

verses.first: I am small and of little account,
verses.second: yet I do not forget your commandments.

verses.first: Your justice is an everlasting justice
verses.second: and your law is the truth.

verses.first: Trouble and distress have come upon me,
verses.second: yet your commandments are my delight.

verses.first: The righteousness of your decrees is everlasting;
verses.second: grant me understanding, that I may live.

verses.first: I call with my whole heart;
verses.second: answer me, O Lord, that I may keep your statutes.

verses.first: I call to you; oh, that you would save me!
verses.second: I will keep your decrees.

verses.first: Early in the morning I cry out to you,
verses.second: for in your word is my trust.

verses.first: My eyes are open in the night watches,
verses.second: that I may meditate upon your promise.

verses.first: Hear my voice, O Lord, according to your loving-kindness;
verses.second: according to your judgments, give me life.

verses.first: They draw near who in malice persecute me;
verses.second: they are very far from your law.

verses.first: You, O Lord, are near at hand,
verses.second: and all your commandments are true.

verses.first: Long have I known from your decrees
verses.second: that you have established them for ever.

verses.first: Behold my affliction and deliver me,
verses.second: for I do not forget your law.

verses.first: Plead my cause and redeem me;
verses.second: according to your promise, give me life.

verses.first: Deliverance is far from the wicked,
verses.second: for they do not study your statutes.

verses.first: Great is your compassion, O Lord;
verses.second: preserve my life, according to your judgments.

verses.first: There are many who persecute and oppress me,
verses.second: yet I have not swerved from your decrees.

verses.first: I look with loathing at the faithless,
verses.second: for they have not kept your word.

verses.first: See how I love your commandments!
verses.second: O Lord, in your mercy, preserve me.

verses.first: The heart of your word is truth;
verses.second: all your righteous judgments endure for evermore.

verses.first: Rulers have persecuted me without a cause,
verses.second: but my heart stands in awe of your word.

verses.first: I am as glad because of your promise
verses.second: as one who finds great spoils.

verses.first: As for lies, I hate and abhor them,
verses.second: but your law is my love.

verses.first: Seven times a day do I praise you,
verses.second: because of your righteous judgments.

verses.first: Great peace have they who love your law;
verses.second: for them there is no stumbling block.

verses.first: I have hoped for your salvation, O Lord,
verses.second: and I have fulfilled your commandments.

verses.first: I have kept your decrees
verses.second: and I have loved them deeply.

verses.first: I have kept your commandments and decrees,
verses.second: for all my ways are before you. Taw Appropinquet deprecatio

verses.first: Let my cry come before you, O Lord;
verses.second: give me understanding, according to your word.

verses.first: Let my supplication come before you;
verses.second: deliver me, according to your promise.

verses.first: My lips shall pour forth your praise,
verses.second: when you teach me your statutes.

verses.first: My tongue shall sing of your promise,
verses.second: for all your commandments are righteous.

verses.first: Let your hand be ready to help me,
verses.second: for I have chosen your commandments.

verses.first: I long for your salvation, O Lord,
verses.second: and your law is my delight.

verses.first: Let me live, and I will praise you,
verses.second: and let your judgments help me.

verses.first: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost;
verses.second: search for your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.

verses.first: When I was in trouble, I called to the Lord;
verses.second: I called to the Lord, and he answered me.

verses.first: Deliver me, O Lord, from lying lips
verses.second: and from the deceitful tongue.

verses.first: What shall be done to you, and what more besides,
verses.second: O you deceitful tongue?

verses.first: The sharpened arrows of a warrior,
verses.second: along with hot glowing coals.

verses.first: How hateful it is that I must lodge in Meshech
verses.second: and dwell among the tents of Kedar!

verses.first: Too long have I had to live;
verses.second: among the enemies of peace.

verses.first: I am on the side of peace,
verses.second: but when I speak of it, they are for war.

verses.first: I lift up my eyes to the hills;
verses.second: from where is my help to come?

verses.first: My help comes from the Lord,
verses.second: the maker of heaven and earth.

verses.first: He will not let your foot be moved
verses.second: and he who watches over you will not fall asleep.

verses.first: Behold, he who keeps watch over Israel
verses.second: shall neither slumber nor sleep;

verses.first: The Lord himself watches over you;
verses.second: the Lord is your shade at your right hand,

verses.first: So that the sun shall not strike you by day,
verses.second: nor the moon by night.

verses.first: The Lord shall preserve you from all evil;
verses.second: it is he who shall keep you safe.

verses.first: The Lord shall watch over your going out and your coming in,
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: I was glad when they said to me,
verses.second: “Let us go to the house of the Lord.”

verses.first: Now our feet are standing
verses.second: within your gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.first: Jerusalem is built as a city
verses.second: that is at unity with itself;

verses.first: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord,
verses.second: the assembly of Israel, to praise the Name of the Lord.

verses.first: For there are the thrones of judgment,
verses.second: the thrones of the house of David.

verses.first: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
verses.second: “May they prosper who love you.

verses.first: Peace be within your walls
verses.second: and quietness within your towers.

verses.first: For my brethren and companions’ sake,
verses.second: I pray for your prosperity.

verses.first: Because of the house of the Lord our God,
verses.second: I will seek to do you good.”

verses.first: To you I lift up my eyes,
verses.second: to you enthroned in the heavens.

verses.first: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters,
verses.second: and the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,

verses.first: So our eyes look to the Lord our God,
verses.second: until he show us his mercy.

verses.first: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy,
verses.second: for we have had more than enough of contempt,

verses.first: Too much of the scorn of the indolent rich,
verses.second: and of the derision of the proud.

verses.first: If the Lord had not been on our side,
verses.second: let Israel now say;

verses.first: If the Lord had not been on our side,
verses.second: when enemies rose up against us;

verses.first: Then would they have swallowed us up alive
verses.second: in their fierce anger toward us;

verses.first: Then would the waters have overwhelmed us
verses.second: and the torrent gone over us;

verses.first: Then would the raging waters
verses.second: have gone right over us.

verses.first: Blessed be the Lord!
verses.second: he has not given us over to be a prey for their teeth.

verses.first: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler;
verses.second: the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

verses.first: Our help is in the Name of the Lord,
verses.second: the maker of heaven and earth.

verses.first: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion,
verses.second: which cannot be moved, but stands fast for ever.

verses.first: The hills stand about Jerusalem;
verses.second: so does the Lord stand round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: The scepter of the wicked shall not hold sway over the land allotted to the just,
verses.second: so that the just shall not put their hands to evil.

verses.first: Show your goodness, O Lord, to those who are good
verses.second: and to those who are true of heart.

verses.first: As for those who turn aside to crooked ways, the Lord will lead them away with the evildoers;
verses.second: but peace be upon Israel.

verses.first: When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion,
verses.second: then were we like those who dream.

verses.first: Then was our mouth filled with laughter,
verses.second: and our tongue with shouts of joy.

verses.first: Then they said among the nations,
verses.second: “The Lord has done great things for them.”

verses.first: The Lord has done great things for us,
verses.second: and we are glad indeed.

verses.first: Restore our fortunes, O Lord,
verses.second: like the watercourses of the Negev.

verses.first: Those who sowed with tears
verses.second: will reap with songs of joy.

verses.first: Those who go out weeping, carrying the seed,
verses.second: will come again with joy, shouldering their sheaves.

verses.first: Unless the Lord builds the house,
verses.second: their labor is in vain who build it.

verses.first: Unless the Lord watches over the city,
verses.second: in vain the watchman keeps his vigil.

verses.first: It is in vain that you rise so early and go to bed so late;
verses.second: vain, too, to eat the bread of toil, for he gives to his beloved sleep.

verses.first: Children are a heritage from the Lord,
verses.second: and the fruit of the womb is a gift.

verses.first: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior
verses.second: are the children of one’s youth.

verses.first: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them!
verses.second: he shall not be put to shame when he contends with his enemies in the gate.

verses.first: Happy are they all who fear the Lord,
verses.second: and who follow in his ways!

verses.first: You shall eat the fruit of your labor;
verses.second: happiness and prosperity shall be yours.

verses.first: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house,
verses.second: your children like olive shoots round about your table.

verses.first: The man who fears the Lord
verses.second: shall thus indeed be blessed.

verses.first: The Lord bless you from Zion,
verses.second: and may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.first: May you live to see your children’s children;
verses.second: may peace be upon Israel.

verses.first: “Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth,”
verses.second: let Israel now say;

verses.first: “Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth,
verses.second: but they have not prevailed against me.”

verses.first: The plowmen plowed upon my back
verses.second: and made their furrows long.

verses.first: The Lord, the Righteous One,
verses.second: has cut the cords of the wicked.

verses.first: Let them be put to shame and thrown back,
verses.second: all those who are enemies of Zion.

verses.first: Let them be like grass upon the housetops,
verses.second: which withers before it can be plucked;

verses.first: Which does not fill the hand of the reaper,
verses.second: nor the bosom of him who binds the sheaves;

verses.first: So that those who go by say not so much as, “The Lord prosper you.
verses.second: We wish you well in the Name of the Lord.”

verses.first: Out of the depths have I called to you, O Lord; Lord, hear my voice;
verses.second: let your ears consider well the voice of my supplication.

verses.first: If you, Lord, were to note what is done amiss,
verses.second: O Lord, who could stand?

verses.first: For there is forgiveness with you;
verses.second: therefore you shall be feared.

verses.first: I wait for the Lord; my soul waits for him;
verses.second: in his word is my hope.

verses.first: My soul waits for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning,
verses.second: more than watchmen for the morning.

verses.first: O Israel, wait for the Lord,
verses.second: for with the Lord there is mercy;

verses.first: With him there is plenteous redemption,
verses.second: and he shall redeem Israel from all their sins.

verses.first: O Lord, I am not proud;
verses.second: I have no haughty looks.

verses.first: I do not occupy myself with great matters,
verses.second: or with things that are too hard for me.

verses.first: But I still my soul and make it quiet, like a child upon its mother’s breast;
verses.second: my soul is quieted within me.

verses.first: O Israel, wait upon the Lord,
verses.second: from this time forth for evermore.

verses.first: Lord, remember David,
verses.second: and all the hardships he endured;

verses.first: How he swore an oath to the Lord
verses.second: and vowed a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

verses.first: “I will not come under the roof of my house,”
verses.second: nor climb up into my bed;

verses.first: I will not allow my eyes to sleep,
verses.second: nor let my eyelids slumber;

verses.first: Until I find a place for the Lord,
verses.second: a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

verses.first: “The ark! We heard it was in Ephratah;
verses.second: we found it in the fields of Jearim.

verses.first: Let us go to God’s dwelling place;
verses.second: let us fall upon our knees before his footstool.”

verses.first: Arise, O Lord, into your resting-place,
verses.second: you and the ark of your strength.

verses.first: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness;
verses.second: let your faithful people sing with joy.

verses.first: For your servant David’s sake,
verses.second: do not turn away the face of your Anointed.

verses.first: The Lord has sworn an oath to David;
verses.second: in truth, he will not break it:

verses.first: “A son, the fruit of your body
verses.second: will I set upon your throne.

verses.first: If your children keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them,
verses.second: their children will sit upon your throne for evermore.”

verses.first: For the Lord has chosen Zion;
verses.second: he has desired her for his habitation:

verses.first: “This shall be my resting-place for ever;
verses.second: here will I dwell, for I delight in her.

verses.first: I will surely bless her provisions,
verses.second: and satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.first: I will clothe her priests with salvation,
verses.second: and her faithful people will rejoice and sing.

verses.first: There will I make the horn of David flourish;
verses.second: I have prepared a lamp for my Anointed.

verses.first: As for his enemies, I will clothe them with shame;
verses.second: but as for him, his crown will shine.”

verses.first: Oh, how good and pleasant it is,
verses.second: when brethren live together in unity!

verses.first: It is like fine oil upon the head
verses.second: that runs down upon the beard,

verses.first: Upon the beard of Aaron,
verses.second: and runs down upon the collar of his robe.

verses.first: It is like the dew of Hermon
verses.second: that falls upon the hills of Zion.

verses.first: For there the Lord has ordained the blessing:
verses.second: life for evermore.

verses.first: Behold now, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord,
verses.second: you that stand by night in the house of the Lord.

verses.first: Lift up your hands in the holy place and bless the Lord;
verses.second: the Lord who made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.

verses.first: Hallelujah ! Praise the Name of the Lord;
verses.second: give praise, you servants of the Lord,

verses.first: You who stand in the house of the Lord,
verses.second: in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.first: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good;
verses.second: sing praises to his Name, for it is lovely.

verses.first: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself
verses.second: and Israel for his own possession.

verses.first: For I know that the Lord is great,
verses.second: and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.first: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in heaven and on earth,
verses.second: in the seas and all the deeps.

verses.first: He brings up rain clouds from the ends of the earth;
verses.second: he sends out lightning with the rain, and brings the winds out of his storehouse.

verses.first: It was he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
verses.second: the firstborn both of man and beast.

verses.first: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt,
verses.second: against Pharaoh and all his servants.

verses.first: He overthrew many nations
verses.second: and put mighty kings to death:

verses.first: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan,
verses.second: and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

verses.first: He gave their land to be an inheritance,
verses.second: an inheritance for Israel his people.

verses.first: O Lord, your Name is everlasting;
verses.second: your renown, O Lord, endures from age to age.

verses.first: For the Lord gives his people justice
verses.second: and shows compassion to his servants.

verses.first: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold,
verses.second: the work of human hands.

verses.first: They have mouths, but they cannot speak;
verses.second: eyes have they, but they cannot see.

verses.first: They have ears, but they cannot hear;
verses.second: neither is there any breath in their mouth.

verses.first: Those who make them are like them,
verses.second: and so are all who put their trust in them.

verses.first: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel;
verses.second: O house of Aaron, bless the Lord.

verses.first: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi;
verses.second: you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.first: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion,
verses.second: who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Give thanks to the God of gods,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Give thanks to the Lord of Lords,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Who only does great wonders,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who by wisdom made the heavens,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who spread out the earth upon the waters,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who created great lights,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: The sun to rule the day,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: The moon and the stars to govern the night,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Who struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And brought out Israel from among them,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: With a mighty hand and a stretched-out arm,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who divided the Red Sea in two,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who led his people through the wilderness,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Who struck down great kings,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And slew mighty kings,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Sihon, king of the Amorites,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And Og, the king of Bashan,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And gave away their lands for an inheritance,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: An inheritance for Israel his servant,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Who remembered us in our low estate,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: And delivered us from our enemies,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever;

verses.first: Who gives food to all creatures,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: Give thanks to the God of heaven,
verses.second: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.first: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept,
verses.second: when we remembered you, O Zion.

verses.first: As for our harps, we hung them up
verses.second: on the trees in the midst of that land.

verses.first: For those who led us away captive asked us for a song, and our oppressors called for mirth:
verses.second: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion.”

verses.first: How shall we sing the Lord’s song
verses.second: upon an alien soil?

verses.first: If I forget you, O Jerusalem,
verses.second: let my right hand forget its skill.

verses.first: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you,
verses.second: if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.

verses.first: Remember the day of Jerusalem, O Lord, against the people of Edom,
verses.second: who said, “Down with it! down with it! even to the ground!”

verses.first: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction,
verses.second: happy the one who pays you back for what you have done to us!

verses.first: Happy shall he be who takes your little ones,
verses.second: and dashes them against the rock!

verses.first: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, with my whole heart;
verses.second: before the gods I will sing your praise.

verses.first: I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your Name,
verses.second: because of your love and faithfulness;

verses.first: For you have glorified your Name
verses.second: and your word above all things.

verses.first: When I called, you answered me;
verses.second: you increased my strength within me.

verses.first: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O Lord,
verses.second: when they have heard the words of your mouth.

verses.first: They will sing of the ways of the Lord,
verses.second: that great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.first: Though the Lord be high, he cares for the lowly;
verses.second: he perceives the haughty from afar.

verses.first: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you keep me safe;
verses.second: you stretch forth your hand against the fury of my enemies; your right hand shall save me.

verses.first: The Lord will make good his purpose for me;
verses.second: O Lord, your love endures for ever; do not abandon the works of your hands.

verses.first: Lord, you have searched me out and known me;
verses.second: you know my sitting down and my rising up; you discern my thoughts from afar.

verses.first: You trace my journeys and my resting-places
verses.second: and are acquainted with all my ways.

verses.first: Indeed, there is not a word on my lips,
verses.second: but you, O Lord, know it altogether.

verses.first: You press upon me behind and before
verses.second: and lay your hand upon me.

verses.first: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me;
verses.second: it is so high that I cannot attain to it.

verses.first: Where can I go then from your Spirit?
verses.second: where can I flee from your presence?

verses.first: If I climb up to heaven, you are there;
verses.second: if I make the grave my bed, you are there also.

verses.first: If I take the wings of the morning
verses.second: and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

verses.first: Even there your hand will lead me
verses.second: and your right hand hold me fast.

verses.first: If I say, “Surely the darkness will cover me,
verses.second: and the light around me turn to night,”

verses.first: Darkness is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day;
verses.second: darkness and light to you are both alike.

verses.first: For you yourself created my inmost parts;
verses.second: you knit me together in my mother’s womb.

verses.first: I will thank you because I am marvelously made;
verses.second: your works are wonderful, and I know it well.

verses.first: My body was not hidden from you,
verses.second: while I was being made in secret and woven in the depths of the earth.

verses.first: Your eyes beheld my limbs, yet unfinished in the womb; all of them were written in your book;
verses.second: they were fashioned day by day, when as yet there was none of them.

verses.first: How deep I find your thoughts, O God!
verses.second: how great is the sum of them!

verses.first: If I were to count them, they would be more in number than the sand;
verses.second: to count them all, my life span would need to be like yours.

verses.first: Oh, that you would slay the wicked, O God!
verses.second: You that thirst for blood, depart from me.

verses.first: They speak despitefully against you;
verses.second: your enemies take your Name in vain.

verses.first: Do I not hate those, O Lord, who hate you?
verses.second: and do I not loathe those who rise up against you?

verses.first: I hate them with a perfect hatred;
verses.second: they have become my own enemies.

verses.first: Search me out, O God, and know my heart;
verses.second: try me and know my restless thoughts.

verses.first: Look well whether there be any wickedness in me
verses.second: and lead me in the way that is everlasting.

verses.first: Deliver me, O Lord, from evildoers;
verses.second: protect me from the violent,

verses.first: Who devise evil in their hearts
verses.second: and stir up strife all day long.

verses.first: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent;
verses.second: adder’s poison is under their lips.

verses.first: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked;
verses.second: protect me from the violent, who are determined to trip me up.

verses.first: The proud have hidden a snare for me and stretched out a net of cords;
verses.second: they have set traps for me along the path.

verses.first: I have said to the Lord, “You are my God;
verses.second: listen, O Lord, to my supplication.

verses.first: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation,
verses.second: you have covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.first: Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O Lord,
verses.second: Nor let their evil plans prosper.

verses.first: Let not those who surround me lift up their heads;
verses.second: let the evil of their lips overwhelm them.

verses.first: Let hot burning coals fall upon them;
verses.second: let them be cast into the mire, never to rise up again.”

verses.first: A slanderer shall not be established on the earth,
verses.second: and evil shall hunt down the lawless.

verses.first: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the poor
verses.second: and render justice to the needy.

verses.first: Surely, the righteous will give thanks to your Name,
verses.second: and the upright shall continue in your sight.

verses.first: O Lord, I call to you; come to me quickly;
verses.second: hear my voice when I cry to you.

verses.first: Let my prayer be set forth in your sight as incense,
verses.second: the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.first: Set a watch before my mouth, O Lord, and guard the door of my lips;
verses.second: let not my heart incline to any evil thing.

verses.first: Let me not be occupied in wickedness with evildoers,
verses.second: nor eat of their choice foods.

verses.first: Let the righteous smite me in friendly rebuke; let not the oil of the unrighteous anoint my head;
verses.second: for my prayer is continually against their wicked deeds.

verses.first: Let their rulers be overthrown in stony places,
verses.second: that they may know my words are true.

verses.first: As when a plowman turns over the earth in furrows,
verses.second: let their bones be scattered at the mouth of the grave.

verses.first: But my eyes are turned to you, Lord God;
verses.second: in you I take refuge; do not strip me of my life.

verses.first: Protect me from the snare which they have laid for me
verses.second: and from the traps of the evildoers.

verses.first: Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
verses.second: while I myself escape.

verses.first: I cry to the Lord with my voice;
verses.second: to the Lord I make loud supplication.

verses.first: I pour out my complaint before him
verses.second: and tell him all my trouble.

verses.first: When my spirit languishes within me, you know my path;
verses.second: in the way wherein I walk they have hidden a trap for me.

verses.first: I look to my right hand and find no one who knows me;
verses.second: I have no place to flee to, and no one cares for me.

verses.first: I cry out to you, O Lord;
verses.second: I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

verses.first: Listen to my cry for help, for I have been brought very low;
verses.second: save me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

verses.first: Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your Name;
verses.second: when you have dealt bountifully with me, the righteous will gather around me.

verses.first: Lord, hear my prayer, and in your faithfulness heed my supplications;
verses.second: answer me in your righteousness.

verses.first: Enter not into judgment with your servant,
verses.second: for in your sight shall no one living be justified.

verses.first: For my enemy has sought my life; he has crushed me to the ground;
verses.second: he has made me live in dark places like those who are long dead.

verses.first: My spirit faints within me;
verses.second: my heart within me is desolate.

verses.first: I remember the time past; I muse upon all your deeds;
verses.second: I consider the works of your hands.

verses.first: I spread out my hands to you;
verses.second: my soul gasps to you like a thirsty land.

verses.first: O Lord, make haste to answer me; my spirit fails me;
verses.second: do not hide your face from me or I shall be like those who go down to the Pit.

verses.first: Let me hear of your loving-kindness in the morning, for I put my trust in you;
verses.second: show me the road that I must walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

verses.first: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord,
verses.second: for I flee to you for refuge.

verses.first: Teach me to do what pleases you, for you are my God;
verses.second: let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

verses.first: Revive me, O Lord, for your Name’s sake;
verses.second: for your righteousness’ sake, bring me out of trouble.

verses.first: Of your goodness, destroy my enemies and bring all my foes to naught,
verses.second: for truly I am your servant.

verses.first: Blessed be the Lord my rock!
verses.second: who trains my hands to fight and my fingers to battle;

verses.first: My help and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer,
verses.second: my shield in whom I trust, who subdues the peoples under me.

verses.first: O Lord, what are we that you should care for us?
verses.second: mere mortals that you should think of us?

verses.first: We are like a puff of wind;
verses.second: our days are like a passing shadow.

verses.first: Bow your heavens, O Lord, and come down;
verses.second: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.first: Hurl the lightning and scatter them;
verses.second: shoot out your arrows and rout them.

verses.first: Stretch out your hand from on high;
verses.second: rescue me and deliver me from the great waters, from the hand of foreign peoples,

verses.first: Whose mouths speak deceitfully
verses.second: and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.

verses.first: O God, I will sing to you a new song;
verses.second: I will play to you on a ten-stringed lyre.

verses.first: You give victory to kings
verses.second: and have rescued David your servant.

verses.first: Rescue me from the hurtful sword
verses.second: and deliver me from the hand of foreign peoples,

verses.first: Whose mouths speak deceitfully
verses.second: and whose right hand is raised in falsehood.

verses.first: May our sons be like plants well nurtured from their youth,
verses.second: and our daughters like sculptured corners of a palace.

verses.first: May our barns be filled to overflowing with all manner of crops;
verses.second: may the flocks in our pastures increase by thousands and tens of thousands; may our cattle be fat and sleek.

verses.first: May there be no breaching of the walls, no going into exile,
verses.second: no wailing in the public squares.

verses.first: Happy are the people of whom this is so!
verses.second: happy are the people whose God is the Lord!

verses.first: I will exalt you, O God my King,
verses.second: and bless your Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: Every day will I bless you
verses.second: and praise your Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised;
verses.second: there is no end to his greatness.

verses.first: One generation shall praise your works to another
verses.second: and shall declare your power.

verses.first: I will ponder the glorious splendor of your majesty
verses.second: and all your marvelous works.

verses.first: They shall speak of the might of your wondrous acts,
verses.second: and I will tell of your greatness.

verses.first: They shall publish the remembrance of your great goodness;
verses.second: they shall sing of your righteous deeds.

verses.first: The Lord is gracious and full of compassion,
verses.second: slow to anger and of great kindness.

verses.first: The Lord is loving to everyone
verses.second: and his compassion is over all his works.

verses.first: All your works praise you, O Lord,
verses.second: and your faithful servants bless you.

verses.first: They make known the glory of your kingdom
verses.second: and speak of your power;

verses.first: That the peoples may know of your power
verses.second: and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

verses.first: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom;
verses.second: your dominion endures throughout all ages.

verses.first: The Lord is faithful in all his words
verses.second: and merciful in all his deeds.

verses.first: The Lord upholds all those who fall;
verses.second: he lifts up those who are bowed down.

verses.first: The eyes of all wait upon you, O Lord,
verses.second: and you give them their food in due season.

verses.first: You open wide your hand
verses.second: and satisfy the needs of every living creature.

verses.first: The Lord is righteous in all his ways
verses.second: and loving in all his works.

verses.first: The Lord is near to those who call upon him,
verses.second: to all who call upon him faithfully.

verses.first: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him;
verses.second: he hears their cry and helps them.

verses.first: The Lord preserves all those who love him,
verses.second: but he destroys all the wicked.

verses.first: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord;
verses.second: let all flesh bless his holy Name for ever and ever.

verses.first: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord, O my soul!
verses.second: I will praise the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

verses.first: Put not your trust in rulers, nor in any child of earth,
verses.second: for there is no help in them.

verses.first: When they breathe their last, they return to earth,
verses.second: and in that day their thoughts perish.

verses.first: Happy are they who have the God of Jacob for their help!
verses.second: whose hope is in the Lord their God;

verses.first: Who made heaven and earth, the seas, and all that is in them;
verses.second: who keeps his promise for ever;

verses.first: Who gives justice to those who are oppressed,
verses.second: and food to those who hunger.

verses.first: The Lord sets the prisoners free; the Lord opens the eyes of the blind;
verses.second: the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down;

verses.first: The Lord loves the righteous; the Lord cares for the stranger;
verses.second: he sustains the orphan and widow, but frustrates the way of the wicked.

verses.first: The Lord shall reign for ever,
verses.second: your God, O Zion, throughout all generations. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God!
verses.second: how pleasant it is to honor him with praise!

verses.first: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem;
verses.second: he gathers the exiles of Israel.

verses.first: He heals the brokenhearted
verses.second: and binds up their wounds.

verses.first: He counts the number of the stars
verses.second: and calls them all by their names.

verses.first: Great is our Lord and mighty in power;
verses.second: there is no limit to his wisdom.

verses.first: The Lord lifts up the lowly,
verses.second: but casts the wicked to the ground.

verses.first: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving;
verses.second: make music to our God upon the harp.

verses.first: He covers the heavens with clouds
verses.second: and prepares rain for the earth;

verses.first: He makes grass to grow upon the mountains
verses.second: and green plants to serve mankind.

verses.first: He provides food for flocks and herds
verses.second: and for the young ravens when they cry.

verses.first: He is not impressed by the might of a horse;
verses.second: he has no pleasure in the strength of a man;

verses.first: But the Lord has pleasure in those who fear him,
verses.second: in those who await his gracious favor.

verses.first: Worship the Lord, O Jerusalem;
verses.second: praise your God, O Zion;

verses.first: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates;
verses.second: he has blessed your children within you.

verses.first: He has established peace on your borders;
verses.second: he satisfies you with the finest wheat.

verses.first: He sends out his command to the earth,
verses.second: and his word runs very swiftly.

verses.first: He gives snow like wool;
verses.second: he scatters hoarfrost like ashes.

verses.first: He scatters his hail like bread crumbs;
verses.second: who can stand against his cold?

verses.first: He sends forth his word and melts them;
verses.second: he blows with his wind, and the waters flow.

verses.first: He declares his word to Jacob,
verses.second: his statutes and his judgments to Israel.

verses.first: He has not done so to any other nation;
verses.second: to them he has not revealed his judgments. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord from the heavens;
verses.second: praise him in the heights.

verses.first: Praise him, all you angels of his;
verses.second: praise him, all his host.

verses.first: Praise him, sun and moon;
verses.second: praise him, all you shining stars.

verses.first: Praise him, heaven of heavens,
verses.second: and you waters above the heavens.

verses.first: Let them praise the Name of the Lord;
verses.second: for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.first: He made them stand fast for ever and ever;
verses.second: he gave them a law which shall not pass away.

verses.first: Praise the Lord from the earth,
verses.second: you sea-monsters and all deeps;

verses.first: Fire and hail, snow and fog,
verses.second: tempestuous wind, doing his will;

verses.first: Mountains and all hills,
verses.second: fruit trees and all cedars;

verses.first: Wild beasts and all cattle,
verses.second: creeping things and winged birds;

verses.first: Kings of the earth and all peoples,
verses.second: princes and all rulers of the world;

verses.first: Young men and maidens,
verses.second: old and young together.

verses.first: Let them praise the Name of the Lord,
verses.second: for his Name only is exalted, his splendor is over earth and heaven.

verses.first: He has raised up strength for his people and praise for all his loyal servants,
verses.second: the children of Israel, a people who are near him. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Hallelujah! Sing to the Lord a new song;
verses.second: sing his praise in the congregation of the faithful.

verses.first: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker;
verses.second: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.first: Let them praise his Name in the dance;
verses.second: let them sing praise to him with timbrel and harp.

verses.first: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people
verses.second: and adorns the poor with victory.

verses.first: Let the faithful rejoice in triumph;
verses.second: let them be joyful on their beds.

verses.first: Let the praises of God be in their throat
verses.second: and a two-edged sword in their hand;

verses.first: To wreak vengeance on the nations
verses.second: and punishment on the peoples;

verses.first: To bind their kings in chains
verses.second: and their nobles with links of iron;

verses.first: To inflict on them the judgment decreed;
verses.second: this is glory for all his faithful people. Hallelujah!

verses.first: Hallelujah! Praise God in his holy temple;
verses.second: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.first: Praise him for his mighty acts;
verses.second: praise him for his excellent greatness.

verses.first: Praise him with the blast of the ram’s-horn;
verses.second: praise him with lyre and harp.

verses.first: Praise him with timbrel and dance;
verses.second: praise him with strings and pipe.

verses.first: Praise him with resounding cymbals;
verses.second: praise him with loud-clanging cymbals.

verses.first: Let everything that has breath
verses.second: praise the Lord. Hallelujah!
